def max_teams(n, groups):
    singles = groups.count(1)
    pairs = groups.count(2)
    
    # Form teams of three from pairs first
    teams_from_pairs = pairs // 2
    pairs -= teams_from_pairs * 2
    
    # Then form teams of three from singles
    teams_from_singles = min(singles // 3, pairs)
    singles -= teams_from_singles * 3

    teams_from_singles_and_pairs = min(singles, pairs * 2) // 2
